info.name: Saina Chit Backend API
info.description:
Postman collection for Saina Chit Funds backend (`chit-backend`).

## Setup
1. Import this collection and `Saina-Chit-Backend.local.postman_environment.json`
2. Select the **Saina Local** environment
3. Run `npm run seed` on the backend, then start the server (`npm run dev`)
4. Use **Auth → Login flows** to request OTP and verify — the access token is saved automatically

## Demo credentials (after seed)
| Role | Auth slug | Phone | Aadhaar | OTP |
|------|-----------|-------|---------|-----|
| Super Admin | super-admin | 9999999999 | 123456789012 | 123456 |
| Branch Store | admin or branch-store | 9888888881 | 111111111111 | 123456 |
| Agent | agent | 9888888882 | 222222222222 | 123456 |
| Bidder | bidder | 9888888883 | 333333333333 | 123456 |

## Auth
Protected routes use `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

request.description: Server liveness check. No authentication required.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Phone + Aadhaar OTP login per role. After **Verify OTP**, access + refresh tokens are saved. Use **Session → Refresh Token** when access expires.

request.description: Use after request-otp returns requires2fa=true.
FE-compatible alias slug `admin` → internal role `branch_store`.
Requires Bearer access token. Returns profile, permissions, and redirectTo.
Rotates refresh token and returns a new access + refresh pair. Reusing an old refresh token revokes the session family.
Revokes the current refresh session (sid from access JWT). Discard both tokens on the client.
Revokes every refresh session for the user (stolen-device recovery).

item.name: Bidder Signup
item.description: Public bidder self-registration (Aadhaar OTP or DigiLocker mock). Use a fresh Aadhaar/phone that is not already seeded. Saves `signupSessionId` and on complete saves `accessToken`.

request.description: 12-digit Aadhaar only. Returns sessionId + maskedPhone. Dev includes mockOtpHint.
Seals read-only KYC profile on the session.
Returns sessionId + authorizationUrl. Mock URL already includes code=mock-digilocker-code.
Send Accept: application/json to get sealed profile instead of browser redirect.
Creates bidder from sealed KYC + phone/currentAddress. Returns JWT (auto-login).

item.name: Agent Signup
item.description: Public agent self-registration (same flow as bidder). Use a fresh Aadhaar/phone.

item.name: Security
item.description: Authenticated. GET/POST /auth/security + unlock. TOTP for SA/branch/agent; screen_lock and biometric for all roles. Login verify-2fa stays under Auth role folders.

request.description: Returns inactivityMinutes and methods with allowed/enabled flags.
Returns QR / secret. Confirm with Enable TOTP (confirm).
Returns webauthnOptions. Complete with enabled:true + webauthnResponse.
Returns webauthnOptions when webauthnResponse is omitted.

item.name: Super Admin
item.description: Requires Super Admin token. Login via **Auth → Super Admin → Verify OTP** first.

request.description: Requires manager tier or full (`*`) permission.
Permissions are auto-assigned from AGENT_DEFAULT.
Requires full (`*`) permission. Tier: `full` | `manager` | `editor`.

item.name: Chits
item.description:
Shared chit CRUD at `/chits`. Roles: super_admin | branch_store | agent (bidder blocked).

**Permissions:** `chits:read` (list/get/summary), `chits:write` (create/update/delete).

**Flow:**
1. Login as Agent (`Auth → Agent → Verify OTP`) — create does not need `agentId`
2. Or login as Super Admin / Branch Store and set `{{agentId}}` (from List Agents)
3. Optional: set `{{bidderId}}` to attach an existing bidder on create/update
4. Create Chit auto-saves `{{chitId}}`

request.description: Scoped list. Agent sees own chits; branch store sees branch chits; super admin sees all.
Dashboard tier aggregates: `{ amountInLakhs, chitCount, bidderCount }`.
Detail + members. Requires `{{chitId}}` from Create or List.
Login as **Agent** first. `agentId` is forced to the logged-in agent. Auto-generates `chitCode`. Saves `{{chitId}}` on success.
Requires `{{agentId}}`. Branch store may only use agents they created. Optional `members` need real `{{bidderId}}` (active bidder). Remove the members array if you have no bidder id yet.
Partial update. Sending `members` replaces the full members list.
Soft-delete: sets `status` to `deleted`. Confirmation UI is client-side.
Alias of branch-store module. Requires Branch Store token.
